correctness.rationale: For reflexive rooted stars P_k and Q_l, k,l>=1, both forward and backward confluence on comparisons r<=a_i force exactly two disjoint cases: root s in S=R(r), all nonempty U_i contain the selected target-leaf core C; or s absent, nonempty S=C and every U_i=C. Isotone maps with root at a target leaf b_j are constant, while root-s maps can independently choose any element of each nonempty U_i; hence exact minimal functional cover rho=c+max(1,max_i|U_i\C|) when s is present, otherwise c, with tight upper bound l+1. Independent algebraic enumeration of each case yields N_(k,l)=(2^(l+1)-1)^k+sum_c binom(l,c)2^(k(l+1-c))+2^l-1 and cumulative A_(k,l)(t) with the stated binomial cutoff. The core PGF is (2^(l+1)-1)^k+2^(k(l+1))((1+z2^-k)^l-1)+((1+z)^l-1); dividing by N and assuming l2^-k->lambda>0 yields e^(lambda(z-1)) and P(s in S)->1. Independent confluence enumeration and rank spectrum agreed in five (k,l) cases, including (2,2) distribution 11,46,31; finite checks do not prove the general normal form/Poisson limit.
